    assert len(raw)==16 and raw==raw[:4]*4

    points=op['speed_curve']['keyframes'];a,b=points[0]['speed'],points[1]['speed'];x1,y1,x2,y2=points[0]['control_points']
    nodes,weights=np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(8);count=4096;grid=np.linspace(0,1,count+1);u=grid[:-1,None]+(nodes[None,:]+1)/(2*count)
